title: Marketing materials – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Use approved marketing materials
hero.lead: Download images, posters, flyers, icons, backgrounds and documents.

body:
Find material

  1. Open Community → Marketing materials.
  2. Enter a term in the search field.
  3. Select a category when needed.
  4. Open the matching card.

Download material

  • One file: select Download.
  • Several files: select Download set.
  • One file from a set: open the file list and select its name.

Manage material

This section is visible only to authorised administrators.

  1. Open Administration → Marketing → Materials.
  2. Select Create material.
  3. Enter a title, description and category.
  4. Upload one or more files.
  5. Select a preview when several files support it.
  6. Enable Published when the material is ready.
  7. Save.
